definitions.explanation: A pair of thin sticks used for eating, held in one hand. The polite form with the prefix お is the standard everyday term.

examples.japanese: お{箸|はし}の{持|も}ち{方|かた}がきれいですね。
{割|わ}り{箸|ばし}はお{箸|はし}が{付|つ}いてこないときに{使|つか}います。
examples.english: You use disposable chopsticks when chopsticks aren't provided.

notes:
The お prefix is standard and not overly formal — most speakers say お{箸|はし} rather than just {箸|はし} in everyday speech. Dropping the お sounds slightly rough.

MATERIALS AND TYPES:
- {割|わ}り{箸|ばし} — disposable (split) chopsticks
- {塗|ぬ}り{箸|ばし} — lacquered chopsticks
- マイ{箸|はし} — one's own personal chopsticks (eco trend)

CHOPSTICK MANNERS ({箸|はし}のマナー): There are many taboos around chopstick use in Japan, including {刺|さ}し{箸|ばし} (stabbing food), {渡|わた}し{箸|ばし} (passing food chopstick-to-chopstick, associated with funeral rites), and {迷|まよ}い{箸|ばし} (hovering over dishes).
